icons.name: home
icons.heading: Home
icons.description: Welcome home: the front door opens. Light: the door leaf swings out on its left hinge, past edge-on, until it lies open against the wall beside the doorway, knocks and bounces once, and soft light shows in the empty doorway; then the door swings shut, latches with a hit and a small rebound, and the light goes out. Strong: the door is flung open, bounces twice against the wall, holds open longer with brighter light, and slams shut with a rebound and a second, smaller knock. The house never moves.

icons.heading: Clock
icons.description: A quarter of an hour passes. Light: the minute hand sweeps from 12 to 3 in one fast move, lands with a hit, recoils and settles; the hour hand is geared to it at a true 12:1 and creeps on 7.5 degrees. Strong: the minute hand jumps in three 5-minute ticks, each a hit with a recoil, the last the hardest with a second, smaller recoil. The hands never pass the new time, the case never moves, and the new time holds.

icons.description: The picture is reframed to a new crop.
